questions.label: (a
questions.text: Describe your approach to AEM Sites.

lines.name: Site build with components and templates
Cloud Manager program, pipelines and access
Author training on the Universal Editor

sections: Our approach
We would deliver this with AEM Sites.
What we would do
We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
We will train authors to edit pages and content in the Universal Editor and hand over authoring guides for the site's components and templates.
After launch
Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with AEM Sites.

What we would do
- We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
- We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
- We will train authors to edit pages and content in the Universal Editor and hand over authoring guides for the site's components and templates.

After launch
- Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.

- Experience League: Universal Editor Introduction: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/implementing/developing/universal-editor/introduction
- Experience League: Post Go-Live: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/migration-journey/post-go-live

questions.label: (b
questions.text: Describe your approach to Adobe Target.

lines.name: Monthly test design, build and analysis

sections: Our approach
We would deliver this with Target.
What we would do
We will enable Target in the datastream, add flicker handling, render Visual and Form-based Experience Composer activities, pass profile and entity data, and validate the setup.
We will add users and roles, create workspaces and properties where you have Target Premium, and set up the reporting, environment and starting audience settings.
We will run an ideation and prioritization workshop, write activity plans with hypotheses and success metrics, then build, QA and launch the first A/B and Experience Targeting activities.
After launch
Each month we will design, build, QA and launch the next activities on the roadmap, analyze results by audience, and share readouts and next steps with stakeholders.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with Target.

What we would do
- We will enable Target in the datastream, add flicker handling, render Visual and Form-based Experience Composer activities, pass profile and entity data, and validate the setup.
- We will add users and roles, create workspaces and properties where you have Target Premium, and set up the reporting, environment and starting audience settings.
- We will run an ideation and prioritization workshop, write activity plans with hypotheses and success metrics, then build, QA and launch the first A/B and Experience Targeting activities.

After launch
- Each month we will design, build, QA and launch the next activities on the roadmap, analyze results by audience, and share readouts and next steps with stakeholders.

questions.label: a
questions.text: Describe your approach to Marketo Engage.

lines.name: Instance, tracking and email domain setup
Program templates, emails and landing pages

sections: Our approach
We would deliver this with Marketo Engage.
What we would do

We will agree the field mapping with the CRM admin before the first sync, connect Marketo Engage to Salesforce or Dynamics, choose which fields sync or stay hidden, and check that the sync is running correctly.

We will complete the initial setup steps and protocols, set up SPF and DKIM, the CNAMEs for branded tracking links and landing pages, install the Munchkin code on the website, and set up users and roles.
We will design the program templates the team will clone (webinar, nurture, newsletter, event), with My Tokens, and build the branded email templates, landing pages and forms in Design Studio.
After launch
Each month we will review Admin, Marketing Activities, Design Studio and Database for clean-up, deliverability and scoring changes, and agree the fixes with your Marketo owner.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with Marketo Engage.

What we would do
- We will agree the field mapping with the CRM admin before the first sync, connect Marketo Engage to Salesforce or Dynamics, choose which fields sync or stay hidden, and check that the sync is running correctly.
- We will complete the initial setup steps and protocols, set up SPF and DKIM, the CNAMEs for branded tracking links and landing pages, install the Munchkin code on the website, and set up users and roles.
- We will design the program templates the team will clone (webinar, nurture, newsletter, event), with My Tokens, and build the branded email templates, landing pages and forms in Design Studio.

After launch
- Each month we will review Admin, Marketing Activities, Design Studio and Database for clean-up, deliverability and scoring changes, and agree the fixes with your Marketo owner.

Sources
- Experience League: Auditing an inherited Marketo Engage instance: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/marketo-learn/auditing-an-inherited-instance/audit-an-inherted-instance
- Experience League: Sync fields for the native CRM connectors: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experiences-by-you/implementing-new-instance/syncing-fields-for-crm-integration
- Getting started with Salesforce sync: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/marketo-learn/tutorials/integrations/salesforce-sync-setup
- Understanding the Microsoft Dynamics Sync: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/marketo/using/product-docs/crm-sync/microsoft-dynamics/understanding-the-microsoft-dynamics-sync
- Experience League: Plan for a new Marketo Engage implementation: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experiences-by-you/implementing-new-instance/planning-for-new-implementation
- Intake and Create blueprint: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/blueprints-learn/architecture/use-case-patterns/b2b-patterns/campaign-intake-and-creation
